{{Quote|I did not know him. But in a sense, I did. Jedi are all the same.|[[Hock Malsuum]]|<ref name="Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows 2">[[Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows 2|''Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows'' 2]]</ref>}}
A '''Cerean''' [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], he was captured by the citizens of a [[Malsuum|desert planet]] and handed over to the local [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] authorities. He was put in a cage, which was installed on the square of the local [[Capital/Legends|capital]].
